captions.help.slots.jungleSisters.wild.text: The Wild symbol can land on any reel and substitutes for all symbols except the Scatter
captions.help.slots.jungleSisters.bonus.text: The Bonus Scatter symbol can appear on reels 2, 3, and 4, and a minimum of 7 Bonus Scatter symbols are required to trigger the bonus round.
Embark on an exciting adventure with Jungle Sisters, a captivating 20-payline slot game featuring an extra multiplier reel and thrilling bonus features. Immerse yourself in the lush atmosphere of Aztec jungles and the world of the Amazons as you spin the reels. Enjoy dynamic gameplay enhanced by stunning graphics and engaging sound effects. For an added thrill, the Bonus Buy feature is available, allowing you to jump straight into the bonus rounds for an extra layer of excitement.
captions.help.slots.jungleSisters.paying.rules.de: Prizes are awarded for matching combinations of symbols. Combinations must appear from left to right on a line, except for scatters. Only the highest win on each line and for each scatter combination is paid. Scatter wins and line wins are combined. The payable displays prizes for the currently selected bet amount.
captions.help.slots.jungleSistersDeluxe.bonus.fea: "Landing 7 or more Scatter symbols on the screen triggers 10 Free Spins. During Free Spins, Scatter symbols will not appear anywhere on the reels, which means that the feature cannot be retriggered. Before the start of the bonus round, the system will randomly select 5 different multipliers from the following possible values: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 20x, 30x, 40x, 50x, and 100x. The selection of these multipliers is based on mathematical probability. These randomly chosen multipliers will serve as potential multipliers for the wins during the Free Spins. While in Free Spin mode, the multiplier scale will change according to these selected values, and any winning combinations during the round will be affected by the applicable multiplier. If the maximum win limit is reached during the Free Spin round, any remaining spins will be canceled, and the maximum payout will be awarded."
captions.help.slots.jungleSistersDeluxe.reel.desc: "In addition to the standard rules, the game features an X Multiplier, which can randomly appear on the left side reel. With five possible multipliers (1x, 2x, 3x, 4x,  5x and 10X), any win can be boosted for even greater rewards. During the bonus round, the multiplier scale will change. Here is an important detail: before the start of the bonus round, the following multiplier values will appear on the board: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, and 100x. From these multipliers, a random selection of any five multiplier values will be chosen (based on mathematical probability), and these selected multipliers will participate in the bonus round."
captions.help.slots.jungleSisters.risk.game.descr: In the game, players have the opportunity to double their winnings with the X2 Gamble Feature. After a winning spin, players can access the Gamble round by clicking the “X2” button. Once the gamble screen appears, a card in the middle of the screen will flash red and black while face down, indicating that the gamble feature is active. To double their winnings, players must correctly guess the color of the card that will be revealed next. If they succeed, their winnings will be doubled. However, if they guess incorrectly, their original win will be lost. At any point, players can use the “Take Win” button to collect their winnings and add them to their main balance.
captions.help.slots.jungleSisters.betBtn.descript: open the menu, and choose your bet.
captions.help.slots.jungleSistersDeluxe.extra.rul:
In the event of a disconnection during gameplay, all accepted bets will still be played out, and any resulting wins will be credited to the player's balance at the end of the round. Please note that after a disconnection, Autoplay mode will be switched off to ensure a fair and enjoyable gaming experience.
It's important to note that any malfunction will void all plays and payouts, and any unfinished round will be terminated.
When you hit a winning combination, you have three options to credit the win amount to your balance: you can start a new spin by clicking the spin button, use the Take Win button to transfer the win to your balance, or use the X2 Double Up feature button and click Take Win.
If you are playing in Autoplay mode, all wins are automatically transferred to your balance.
